doc.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Dinah Washington's impact
summary: Dinah was the one singer whose lyrics you could understand and she was hot stuff.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Okay. Did you shake your head to say . . .
See, it‘s all . . . people like that, these dynamic personalities and musicians and vocalists, it‘s all said once they sing a song. That‘s it. What can you do?
Even in terms of the impact they have on you?

Oh, shit, she had a great impact on me. Number one, during that time she was the only one you could understand the lyrics. Even Sarah, you know, Sarah would slur those lyrics sometimes. What you saying, baby? You know. But Dinah was there. She was hot stuff.
